fs/stat#

What the disk knows about an entry: its kind, size, permissions, times and identity.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let stat = FileEntry(Path("notes.txt")).stat();
stat::Shape::kind == FileKind.file;
stat::Shape::size;                                // bytes
stat.mode().owner()::Access::writable;
stat.times().modification();                      // Instant
stat.identity().same(other.identity());           // the same file?

Description#

What the disk knows about an entry: its kind, size, permissions, times and identity.

Every platform's metadata comes in the same shape. Not every file system records a creation time: creation() then throws MissingCreationTime.
